messages:
sophia: Quick recap from the postmortem — token counting lag caused ~48h backlog for some customers, which bubbled into incorrect invoice lines. We need a concrete remediation plan + owners by EOD.

mike: Agree. I can take the usage-side fix (fixing aggregator window logic). ETA 2 weeks? I want to ship a hotfix for the most common path in 72h.

anita: I'll own the invoice corrections and customer comms. Can we get a list of affected invoices by tomorrow morning?

devon: tagging in billing-bot to run the extraction for affected customers now.

billing-bot: Run started: query "SELECT tenant_id, invoice_id, reported_tokens, corrected_tokens FROM metering_events WHERE event_time BETWEEN '2026-02-01' AND '2026-02-03' AND corrected = false LIMIT 1000;"

julia: Two quick asks: 1) Are there recurring patterns (same customers hit multiple times)? 2) Any threshold for auto-credits vs manual review?

sophia: Good call. From PM side we prefer auto-crediting under $50 per invoice. Above that, manual review and note in invoice. For recurring >3 times in 30d, we escalate to account manager.

mike: Hotfix plan: change aggregator window from 5m -> 30s for active streams, add a fallback flush on worker restart. Will open PR and tag @devops for rollout. Hotfix target: 72h. Full fix (rework aggregator) target: 14 days.

anita: For invoices: I'll prepare a CSV of affected invoice_ids and customer contact emails. billing-bot — can you add the delta column and total credit amount?

billing-bot: Extraction complete (partial): 74 rows. Added fields: token_delta, estimated_credit_usd. Sample row: tenant_8421, invoice_20260203_17, 12_450, $1.49

devon: I'll prep a script to apply credits in staging and generate a preview. Need access to payment-run tool. @anita — can you confirm who on finance signs off?

anita: Finance signoff: me + julia for credits > $250. For automatic small credits < $50 I will approve a batched apply after review.

julia: I'll do a quick audit on the 74 rows for duplicates and recurring flags.

sophia: Outstanding action items (quick list):
- A1: Hotfix aggregator window & flush on restart — owner: mike — due: 72h — status: in progress.
- A2: End-to-end detection query + affected invoice CSV — owner: billing-bot / devon — due: tomorrow 10:00 — status: running.
- A3: Apply credits (staging preview) — owner: devon/anita — due: 3 days.
- A4: Customer communications template + who to CC — owner: anita — due: 2 days.
- A5: Root cause full remediation & test harness — owner: mike — due: 14 days.
- A6: Recurrence detection (flag customers with >3 incidents/30d) — owner: julia — due: 7 days.

mike: I'll post PR link once ready. Also adding a metric (metering.delta_unreported_tokens) to alert on >1000 tokens/minute backlog to catch earlier.

anita: Can we get a priority label for invoices so CS knows which accounts to proactively reach out to? Suggest: priority = credit_amount > $100 or recurring flag = true.

julia: I will add a column `priority_flag` to the CSV.

devon: Staging apply script ready, waiting on access. If finance approves, we can do a dry-run tonight.

sophia: Decision: do dry-run tonight (no customer emails) and apply small credits tomorrow morning for < $50. Larger credits staged for manual signoff. I'll follow up in case notes.

mike: FYI I'll also add unit tests for the rolling window behavior and a small load test to simulate churn.

anita: Thanks. I'll draft the customer message: short apology, explanation (token counting lag), credit line, ops contact. Will share for review in #finance tomorrow.

julia: Noted. Also logging action: tag incidents in the customer history so we can surface to AMs.

sophia: One more ask — can we add a recurring-incident postmortem meta ticket so we track how often billing bugs repeat? Owner: @julia?

julia: I'll create the meta ticket and link to this thread.

mike: PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood-inference/usage-collector/pulls/312 (draft)

billing-bot: Dry-run results: applied credits preview generated for 74 rows, total estimated liability $112.73. No duplicates detected in staging preview.

anita: Great. I'll review and sign off on small credits after audit.

sophia: Thanks team. I'll send an internal summary to eng/product/legal after credits applied. Closing thread once A1-A4 done. :white_check_mark:
